description: This PHP class 'CandidateActionHistory' provides methods to retrieve lists of candidate action history IDs, including accessible IDs and IDs appropriate for interviewers, by utilizing constants from the 'CandidateService' and 'WorkflowStateMachine' classes.

classes.name: CandidateActionHistory
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for managing and retrieving candidate action history IDs, with methods tailored for general and interviewer-specific action IDs.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Returns an array of candidate action history IDs that are accessible, combining status and other actions.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIdsForInterviewer
methods.description: Returns an array of candidate action history IDs suitable for interviewers by excluding specific actions related to offers, refusals, hiring, or rejection.
